title: UPPETITE Elbi
summary: A route-aware food discovery system for UPLB and Los Baños that combines structured place data, campus walking context, local personal tools and community-maintained records.

title: IMS Academic Hub
summary: A mobile-first IMS student system connecting indoor wayfinding, published academic information and private local grade tools through shared room and space identities.

title: Pasada
summary: A transport-system concept exploring how passenger uncertainty and aggregate demand signals could be modeled around jeepney routes without pretending the data already exists.

title: Disaster Response Platform
summary: A connectivity-resilient emergency-reporting concept for the Philippines that structures messages into incidents while keeping uncertainty and human authority explicit.
